description: Base de données d'Inventaires de cycle de vie modélisant la fin de vie des équipements électriques et électroniques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ecosystem. Created to support eco-design, these databases measure the end-of-life environmental impacts of household and professional electrical and electronic equipment (EEE) according to their composition. Available free of charge to all manufacturers of electrical and electronic equipment, these bases are especially aimed at users of Life Cycle Analysis (LCA) software. Coverage: ecosystem. The portal shows the English title as "Database of Life Cycle Inventories Modelling the End of Life of Electrical and Electronic Equipment" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ecosystem. Its keywords include recyclage, ecoconception, deee, base-de-donnees, impact-sur-lenvironnement, acv. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2019-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
